# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c28 P27](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0027), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril Lisle is an exceptionally handsome and refined young man with dark, wavy hair and large, captivating dark eyes. He is tall and well-built, possessing broad shoulders, a well-shaped chin, and a charming, deep smile that illuminates his expressive features.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c36 P19](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0019), [v1 c38 P39](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0039)_

## Personality

Cyril is an polished, gentle, and courteous gentleman who behaves with constant respect. He is romantically inclined and capable of expressing intense, poetic devotion. However, he lacks a strong sense of humor, which sometimes causes him to miss jokes or take lighthearted situations too seriously. His romantic passions tend to be fervent yet fleeting, leading him to fall deeply in love multiple times in succession.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P31](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0031), [v1 c21 P50](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0050), [v1 c22 P5](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0005), [v1 c28 P28](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0028), [v1 c28 P44](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0044), [v1 c29 P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 c33 P25](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0025), [v1 c33 P37](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0037), [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c36 P36](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0036), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)_

- handsome and charming  <sub>[v1 c28 P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012)</sub>

- writing poetry
- academic excellence at university  <sub>[v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- win the academic medal at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v1 c34 P16](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0016), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005)</sub>
- win the heart of Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c38 P17](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

After pausing his university studies to travel Europe with his mother, Cyril returns to Wexcombe College as a Junior. He meets Nell Harcourt when assisting her during a sudden rainstorm in the park, and soon begins courting her earnestly with gifts of flowers and poetry. Although his family initially holds reservations, Cyril remains devoted to Nell throughout his student years. Following graduation, he formally proposes to Nell at the park pavilion where they first met, but she realizes she does not truly love him and rejects his proposal. Though deeply hurt, Cyril accepts her decision and departs, eventually recovering and moving on as he had in past infatuations.

_Sources: [v1 c25 P38](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0038), [v1 c25 P41](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0041), [v1 c25 P48](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0048), [v1 c29 P14](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0014), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c35 P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 c36 P30](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0030), [v1 c38 P17](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0017), [v1 c38 P21](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0021), [v1 c38 P31](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0031), [v1 c38 P39](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0039)_

## Background by volume

- grew up in a wealthy and elite family in Portmaris  <sub>[v1 c29 P19](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0019), [v1 c34 P13](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0013)</sub>
- spent two years traveling in Europe with his mother due to her poor health  <sub>[v1 c25 P38](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0038), [v1 c28 P30](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0030)</sub>
- attended Wexcombe College prior to traveling abroad, then returned to complete his Arts degree  <sub>[v1 c25 P38](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0038)</sub>
